collection.title: VW Golf Hatchback 2003 to 2005 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a VW Golf Hatchback 2003 to 2005 model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Golf Hatchback which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
